field_decisions.value: The Act sunsets upon either: (1) the task force issuing a recommendation AND a Zoning Regulation text amendment being passed into law; OR (2) conclusion of the Comprehensive Rezoning process; OR (3) no later than November 2, 2027. The amendment strikes “18 months after the Effective Date of this Act” and adds the fixed date.
field_decisions.reason: The first alternative requires both events; the rezoning conclusion and the outer date are separate alternatives.

field_decisions.value: Source-only classification: During the Effective Period, §1 bars acceptance of plan submissions for proposed development of a data processing and telecommunications center, subject to §6.E. Section 1 does not prohibit redlines to a previously approved development plan OR administrative approvals associated with an existing building AND a previously approved development plan. Section 6.D says site development plan applications filed after the Effective Date under the specified development review process may not proceed and shall not be considered for plan approval. Section 6.E excludes any State or local government entity or allied agencies, including HCPSS, HCC, and HCLS. Present force and occurrence of sunset events are not established.
field_decisions.reason: The proposed status compresses the scope of the submission restriction and changes §6.D’s “shall not be considered for plan approval” to “receiving plan approval.” Its current-force caveat is appropriate, but the source-only wording should preserve those distinctions.
